I replied to Ilse in our DM. I said the possible Bay 35 move for the Tansley Parcel depot stays between us, that I won't repeat it in a channel, to anyone else, or in notes, and that if it's confirmed they can tell me where it should go.

I didn't save the rumour to GBrain or to memory. I did one GBrain search, which turned up only the old incident record, `#inc-tansley-carrier-api` from 2025-09-03. That record doesn't say which depot it was or mention any site change.
